en-US.description: Terminal UI for backing up and restoring Microsoft Intune via Microsoft Graph
en-US.longDescription:
TenuVault TUI backs up, restores, compares, and syncs Microsoft Intune
configuration via Microsoft Graph, from a single terminal binary.
en-US.name: tenuvault
en-US.releaseNotes:
Changes
- Show the selected tenant's license in the sidebar badge and License heading (#345)
- Name new tenants after their organization when some tenant counts cannot be read (#346)
- Publish stable releases to WinGet and Homebrew (#344)
- Describe the 14 day automatic Pro trial on the docs site (#343)
- Explain damaged backup files by reason on the Backup page (#341)
- Show the Pro trial in the setup without asking for a decision (#340)
- Keep first-run setup resumable, cancellable and free of duplicate tenants (#339)
- Use the window's width on the Connect step and reuse an existing TenuVault app registration (#337)
- Let admins resume a Pro trial they ended early (#333)
- Connect a tenant with one Microsoft sign-in, without a script (#336)
- Sign in through the browser in the setup script, without Graph modules (#335)
- Bring the marketing screenshots in line with the current app (#334)
Compare with 0.5.1
